### Governing base rules: full sentence inventory and retired surface

#### compute_evt_category_meters → base_evt_category_meters_cb3b52e4.json

1. The primary instance package has vcpu_count virtual cores, memory_gib memory and boot_disk_gb included boot storage.
2. Standard Linux primary usage uses the ordinary primary price.
3. For dedicated configuration multiply the undiscounted primary rate by dedicated_factor before the normal discount priority.
4. For spot configuration use spot_discount instead of every commitment, promotion and portfolio discount; spot is mutually exclusive with a reservation and approved negotiated pricing.
5. Meter code boot_storage bills only provisioned GB-month above boot_disk_gb at boot_disk_rate.
6. windows_license bills actual vCPU-hours at windows_license_rate and linux_license at linux_license_rate, independently of compute discounts.
7. snapshot bills GB-month at snapshot_rate; image_export bills processed GB at image_export_rate.
8. internet_egress bills actual monthly GB beyond included_egress_gb at egress_rate.
9. Resource_count, measured duration and the selected tier vcpu_count determine licensed vCPU-hours; changing capacity splits intervals.
10. A zero-rate license or included transfer creates no charge.
11. The separate Network contract never rebills transfer already marked as compute-managed on its source resource export.
12. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using amount_precision and rounding_mode and tax under evt_tax.
13. An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval_start then source_event_id within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.
14. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.
15. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are POLICY_NOT_COVERED instead of guessed prices.
16. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.
17. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.
18. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included_quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice.
19. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

> ## Formal basis

> Virtual Compute — The primary instance package has virtual core count virtual cores, memory in GiB memory and included boot storage in GB included boot storage. Standard Linux primary usage uses the ordinary primary price. For dedicated configuration multiply the undiscounted primary rate by dedicated tenancy multiplier before the normal discount priority. For spot configuration use spot discount fraction instead of every commitment, promotion and portfolio discount; spot is mutually exclusive with a reservation and approved negotiated pricing. Meter code boot storage bills only provisioned GB-month above included boot storage in GB at boot disk rate. windows license bills actual vCPU-hours at windows license rate and linux license at linux license rate, independently of compute discounts. image export bills processed GB at image export rate. internet egress bills actual monthly GB beyond included monthly internet transfer in GB at egress rate. Resource count, measured duration and the selected tier virtual core count determine licensed vCPU-hours; changing capacity splits intervals. A zero-rate license or included transfer creates no charge. The separate Network contract never rebills transfer already marked as compute-managed on its source resource export. An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. 8. Review alone books no money.

#### compute_evt_service_credit → base_evt_service_credit_1b35d21b.json

1. For a service_credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive credited_amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.
2. For a service_credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit_claim_days after the official incident closes.
3. For a newly filed claim, frozen handling time is its notice_at; the request is recorded immediately.
4. Later review and credit use that recorded notice_at to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review.
5. Add credit_claim_days UTC calendar dates to incident_closed_at, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods.
6. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit.
7. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage_exclusions.
8. Availability at or above sla_target_percent gives no credit.
9. Below the target choose the first descending sla_credit_bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability_percent.
10. Multiply the original source charge net_amount by that fraction; subtract the service_credit_net component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit_cap_fraction of that original net amount.
11. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with amount_precision and rounding_mode.
12. Apply the original tax component proportionately.
13. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists.
14. This service-credit branch applies only to source_subtype service_credit; evt_correction applies only to source_subtype correction.
15. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write.
16. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered.
17. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive credited_amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

#### compute_evt_tax → base_evt_tax_571d0be1.json

1. The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

6. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are POLICY_NOT_COVERED, not assumed exempt.
7. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount.
8. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

### Atomic tool contracts

`allocate_compute_snapshot_3bc9aa3a` → `snapshot_allocation_entry_8ba587f3.json`. Complete source interface:

> Record the compute-attributable GB-month allocation of one shared snapshot export. This creates a completed nonfinancial entitlement record without changing raw meters or the account receivable. The returned event identifier confirms success.
> 
> Args:
>     compute_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the compute contract, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.
>     customer_id: Id class — Identifier of the customer profile, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.
>     compute_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the source-correlated evidence packet returned by find_compute_events: the compute service record with source_subtype review, source_event_id equal to the original snapshot charge, and related_event_id equal to that charge's snapshot export reference.
>     source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the original snapshot invoice line, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.
>     related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the export, allocation or approved review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.
>     quantity: Fixed-format class — The quantity in units of GB-month, representation Decimal quantity to six decimal places; supplied already rounded half-up to six decimal places at calculation completion, with no empty value.
> 
> Returns:
>     String "Recorded compute_service_record" followed by compute_event_id, the new business event identifier as a string. This successful receipt confirms the completed accounting effect described above.

Judgement: owner/unlock/invocation, required arguments and types, signed monetary or six-decimal quantity format, exact receipt/object roles, status and financial/nonfinancial effect match. Underlying create writes the described event type/status, original source, related evidence, signed amount/net, zero tax and request linkage. The tool is atomic; successful invocation itself is not used to prove policy correctness.

`review_compute_snapshot_6efd32f0` → `snapshot_review_entry_e421c2ad.json`. Complete source interface:

> Record an accountant review of one shared snapshot charge against its allocation evidence. This creates an approved incorrect review containing the corrected local subtotal without posting money. The returned event identifier confirms success.
> 
> Args:
>     compute_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the compute contract, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.
>     customer_id: Id class — Identifier of the customer profile, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.
>     compute_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the completed compute-attributable snapshot allocation for the original charge, copied from its successful allocation receipt or find_compute_events; use the identical allocation reference supplied in related_event_id.
>     source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the original snapshot invoice line, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.
>     related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the export, allocation or approved review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.
>     net_amount: Fixed-format class — The net_amount in units of USD, representation USD to two decimals; supplied already rounded half-up to two decimal places at calculation completion, with no empty value.

> 
> Virtual Compute — The primary instance package has virtual core count virtual cores, memory in GiB memory and included boot storage in GB included boot storage. Standard Linux primary usage uses the ordinary primary price. For dedicated configuration multiply the undiscounted primary rate by dedicated tenancy multiplier before the normal discount priority. For spot configuration use spot discount fraction instead of every commitment, promotion and portfolio discount; spot is mutually exclusive with a reservation and approved negotiated pricing. Meter code boot storage bills only provisioned GB-month above included boot storage in GB at boot disk rate. windows license bills actual vCPU-hours at windows license rate and linux license at linux license rate, independently of compute discounts. image export bills processed GB at image export rate. internet egress bills actual monthly GB beyond included monthly internet transfer in GB at egress rate. Resource count, measured duration and the selected tier virtual core count determine licensed vCPU-hours; changing capacity splits intervals. A zero-rate license or included transfer creates no charge. The separate Network contract never rebills transfer already marked as compute-managed on its source resource export. An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included primary quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.
